title: bash-classify match rules
description: Command shapes for `bash-classify match --rules`. Within one rule every given condition must hold; rules are independent of each other.

rules.description: The command shapes to look for

CommandPath.description: A resolved command path, binary first: [glab, mr, note]

name.description: Rule name, unique within the file; reported back on every match

command.description: Prefix match against the resolved command path, so [glab, mr, note] also matches `glab --repo x mr note`

except.description: Command paths excluded from the match, also by prefix

any_option.description: At least one of these options must be present, as typed; a declared cluster -wc counts as -w and -c, and --key=value counts as --key

any_arg_matches.description: Python re.search pattern applied to every argument token: argv[1:] minus the resolved subcommand words
